name: manual-ask
description: A quiet planning chat the automatic checks should leave alone, then the user triggers a manual ask (intent: answer) right after an ambiguous remark about the spring option's numbers. A manual ask must ALWAYS produce a card, even when the model would rather stay silent.

utterances.speaker: Jo
utterances.text: So — spring or autumn for the workshop series. That's the real decision today.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: Walk me through where you've got to.

utterances.speaker: Jo
utterances.text: Venue costs are flat year-round; facilitation is the variable bit.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: And demand-wise, autumn usually books better for us.

utterances.speaker: Jo
utterances.text: Usually, yes. Honestly, I'm still not sure the numbers work for the spring option at all.

utterances.speaker: Jo
utterances.text: Anyway — we don't have to decide this second.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: Let's pencil in autumn and revisit once the facilitator quotes land.
